Shaheen Bhatt told the Hindustan Times that when Alia Bhatt was four years old she staged a "ragebait" prank, telling her sister she was not the biological child of their parents.

The anecdote was shared alongside references to Alia’s current projects, including the young‑adult rom‑com "Don’t Be Shy," and was used to illustrate the siblings’ use of Gen Z slang.

Shaheen highlighted the phrase "came free with Parle‑G" as the punchline of the joke, a colloquial expression that resonated with the siblings during the incident.
